Definition: a lily (from its whiteness), as a flower of architectural ornament; also a (straight) trumpet (from the tubular shape)
BiblicalUsage: 1) lily; 1a) probably any lily-like flower; 1b) Shoshannim, in title of Ps 45:1
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
